judgment.notes: Statement and compiler-printed type both quantify over every n and real scalar function on Fin n → ℝ, assuming continuity and compact topological support and concluding Integrable for canonical product Lebesgue volume. There is no positivity, dimension restriction, norm bound, or extra premise. Specialization of the more general native theorem is direct.

judgment.application: Paragraph 3 applies this to e, d, and the scalar derivative products, after obtaining continuous spatial sections and topological supports contained in the closed compact slab set C. The original support assumption supplies C separately for each [t₀/2,3t₀/2]; no compact set uniform for all positive times is needed. The derivative sections, rather than u itself, have compact support, respecting the fixed-vector perturbation interpretation.
